FFmpeg and FFprobe 9.0.2 for macOS Intel, supplied by Evermeet.
The binaries report GPL version 3 or later and include libmp3lame and libvorbis.
See COPYING.GPLv3 for the GPL text and manifest.json for archive checksums.

Upstream download and build notes: https://evermeet.cx/ffmpeg/
FFmpeg source: https://ffmpeg.org/download.html

These archives are available for local development. Before public
redistribution, supply corresponding source and meet the GPL obligations for
the FFmpeg build and its included dependencies.
